- Every captured file is `gofmt`-clean.
- No second copy of the module exists anywhere on the filesystem to serve as a pristine reference (I checked the disposable runtime GOPATH too).

I corrected an earlier overstatement in the report: rather than claiming every root file is read, it now lists precisely the remaining unread-by-me support files (`commands.go`, `peersjson.go`, `inmem_store.go`, `inmem_snapshot.go`, `discard_snapshot.go`, `transport.go`, `testing_batch.go`) and unwalked regions of `api.go`/`config.go`/`snapshot.go`.
